authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/expressive/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/expressive/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a controller the chart marks Recognized, with the name and range it prints, sent on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The chart is for USB MIDI port 2, the sound engine port, and every controller here answers on the master channel (channel 1, the MPE master): the channel variable.
The macros' destinations are set per preset, so what each one changes depends on the preset loaded.

Left out, the wheel, the pedals, bank select and the MPE+ resolution byte, which are the player's: CC 0 Bank Select (MSB), CC 1 Modulation Wheel / Pedal 2, CC 64 Pedal 1, CC 87 MPE+ LSB Aftertouch / Presure.
Left out, rows the chart marks not recognized: CC 83 EQ tilt value, CC 84 EQ frequency.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends the controllers its chart marks Transmitted
